
```{r}
#| label: extract land cover data
qry_aoo <- exact_extract(r0, slc_aoo)
names(qry_aoo) <- slc_aoo$id
res <- code2lc(qry_aoo, as.character(1988:2024))
```


```{r}
#| fig-cap: Changes in counts of pixels per class per year for the whole region of interest.
#| fig-label: roi-classes
#| fig-width: 9
res |> 
    group_by(class,year) |> 
    summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
    ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, fill=class)) + 
        geom_area() +
        theme_linedraw() +
        theme(legend.position="top")
```
